name: Harbor Residence
brief: Create a warm, measured property walkthrough. Lead with the harbor outlook, then show the living spaces, bedrooms and practical amenities. Keep narration grounded in visible features.

scenes.name: Sea-view bedroom
scenes.narration: 现在来到这间卧室，整面落地窗正对海景，高层视野开阔，白天采光充足。

scenes.name: Living & dining
scenes.narration: 步入客厅，港湾、城市天际线与远山尽收眼底；窗边弧形窗台搭配黑色沙发与浅色地板，简约明亮，右侧还衔接了高脚餐桌与吧台组成的用餐角。

scenes.name: Secondary bedroom
scenes.narration: 这间卧室同样拥有整面落地窗，窗外可见设施与远山轮廓。

scenes.name: Workspace & storage
scenes.narration: 这间明亮卧室配有嵌入式书桌，白色推拉门衣柜和双人床。

scenes.name: Bay-window bedroom
scenes.narration: 卧室配弧形大窗，多扇可开启，窗台作展示架。

scenes.name: Kitchen
scenes.narration: 厨房有黑色台面与燃气灶，窗边引入自然光。

scenes.name: Bathroom
scenes.narration: 卫生间配备淋浴和马桶。
